browser.environment: Headless Chromium; in-memory fixture with mocked API responses
checks: Stored Arabic scenario displayed without an API request.
Opening the panel did not submit the form or reveal answer feedback.
Arabic RTL panel fits a 390-pixel mobile viewport without horizontal overflow.
The same control closes the panel.
An unconfigured mock API shows a clear message without substituting an answer explanation.
A successful mock response using the existing POST /api/scenario contract renders.
Normal answer submission remains independent of the scenario control.
No uncaught browser JavaScript errors and no external network requests.

limitations: The original full application source and deployment workflow are not present in this repository.

Passing fixture tests does not establish that the live site is fixed.
